papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.abstract: Retrieval augmented generation combines parametric generation with a non-parametric dense vector index for knowledge-intensive tasks and provenance.

papers.title: HNSW: Efficient and Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract: Hierarchical navigable small world graphs provide efficient scalable approximate nearest-neighbor search.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: The Transformer architecture relies entirely on attention mechanisms and removes recurrence from sequence transduction.

papers.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
papers.abstract: Language model performance degrades when relevant information appears in the middle of a long input context, motivating better retrieval and context assembly.

papers.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction
papers.abstract: ColBERT uses contextual late interaction over token embeddings to enable efficient passage retrieval with fine-grained matching.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention
papers.abstract: An IO-aware exact attention algorithm reduces memory reads and writes through tiling, improving speed on GPUs.
